mapper.insert: insert into rating(order_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, score, comment, created_time) values (#{orderId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: select * from rating where to_user_id = #{toUserId} order by created_time desc

select r.order_id as orderId, r.score as score, r.comment as comment, r.created_time as createdTime, r.from_user_id as fromUserId, u.username as fromUsername from order_detail d join rating r on r.order_id = d.order_id left join user u on u.id = r.from_user_id where d.goods_id = #{goodsId} and r.comment is not null and r.comment != '' order by r.created_time desc limit #{size}
select * from rating where from_user_id = #{fromUserId} order by created_time desc
mapper.delete: delete from rating where id = #{id} and from_user_id = #{fromUserId}
